description: This file defines a PHP trait named UserRoleManagerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides methods to access User Role Manager services and helpers via a dependency injection container, facilitating role management functionalities.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of AbstractUserRoleManager or BasicUserRoleManager by retrieving the user role manager service from the dependency container.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserRoleManagerHelper by retrieving the helper service from the dependency container.
